text:
Maria Chen: Heads up — I'm starting a light cleanup to consolidate health signals for onboarding playbooks. Goal: reduce false-positives from legacy fields (account_stage, onboarding_flag_old). Doing a dry-run on staging today. Anyone relying on those fields pls shout.
Samir Patel: Thanks — tagging eng infra. What exact fields are you dropping?
Maria Chen: primary ones: `account_stage`, `onboarding_flag_old`, `last_touched_by_legacy`. Affects playbooks: onboarding/welcome, nudge-workflow, and the re-engage sampler.
Raj Singh: We have a webhook consumer in analytics that still reads `account_stage`. I'll update -> building a shim in the transform layer. ETA EOD.
Olivia Park: Can you post the dry-run output when ready? Enablement needs to update training docs and runbook examples.
Maria Chen: Dropping sample SQL used for staging check: ```sql
SELECT id, account_stage, onboarding_flag_old, last_touched_by_legacy
FROM accounts
WHERE created_at > '2023-01-01' AND env='staging';
```
playbook-bot: Dry-run finished: 18 accounts would change health bucket, 3 playbooks would be triggered differently. No errors. Summary CSV: /staging/reports/hygiene-dryrun-4019.csv
Samir Patel: Can we run a delta sync to validate in prod-safe window? Suggest: `./hygiene-sync --dry-run --sample 1000` then `./hygiene-sync --apply --throttle 50` if results look good.
Maria Chen: Agree. Proposed schedule: sample run tomorrow 03:00 PDT (low traffic). If clean, roll next week in 2 phases (10% -> 100%).
Raj Singh: Heads up — need new mapping for `onboarding_status.v2` in telemetry. I'll push migration and notify cs-telemetry and analytics.
Olivia Park: :thumbsup: I'll update playbook docs and internal enablement one-pager. Also request: add a manual confirm checkbox in the CS UI for accounts with any manual touches before we flip health bucket.
Samir Patel: One more ask: add an audit log tag `cs_hygiene_migration_4019` on any write so we can revert/provide diff quickly. Also keep a snapshot for 30d.
Maria Chen: Will add the tag and snapshot. Thanks team. Ping me if you want to join live during the sample run or want the CSV.
